purpose: Company-wide signal normalization, deduplication, severity classification, notification budgeting, escalation, and receipt retention.

receipt.description: Expected system activity, skipped/cancelled work, or successful receipts.

notice.description: Non-urgent drift, source-ready gaps, or branch/test failures without live impact.

warning.description: Mainline/release degradation or repeated dependency failure that needs owner attention.

critical.description: Verified live customer impact, security/compliance danger, data loss, or blocked money movement requiring immediate human action.

evidence_rules: A failed job is not a live outage unless live impact is independently verified.
cancelled and skipped jobs are receipts unless another signal proves impact.
External notification requires a stable fingerprint and evidence state.
Recovery messages coalesce with the incident they close.
Financial obligations, invoices, collections, refunds, payments, contracts, destructive releases, and trust-sensitive actions retain their existing human approval gates.
